criteria: 14 matchdays of 4 fixtures for 8 clubs; every club is in exactly one fixture per matchday; every ordered pair meets once; matchdays 8..14 mirror 1..7
fixtureOf returns the very fixture at its index, matchday 1 puts clubs 0 and 7 in fixture 0 with club 0 at home, out-of-range input throws RangeError
The schedule table is deeply frozen

steps.name: Add the deterministic match model and its calibration
criteria: Seed 31 matchday 1 club 0 plays to the ADR-0011 golden 1-2 with three goals; default seed 20260 gives 0-1 with 65' Joren Northcott; results are pure and deterministic
Scores are 0 to 9, minutes 1 to 90 in order, scorers never goalkeepers, stronger eleven never scores fewer; match.ts uses no ambient randomness, time or pow/exp/log
Same commit git mv-s match.test.ts, match-calibration.test.ts (K1-K5, incl. K2 canonical-figure pin) and fixtures/lowest-rated-xi.ts into tests/acceptance/S-006/
Stream-table comment added in squad.ts; 56 match streams 200..255, all 73 stream numbers distinct
ci:lint, ci:typecheck, ci:test and ci:e2e stay green, including names-avoid-match-words
steps.scenario_name: when seed 31's matchday-1 match of club 0 plays, then Netherwold Borough lose 1–2 to Marlbrook Athletic with the three ADR-0011 goals (strengths 130 and 143) @walking_skeleton @driving_port @contract-shape:pure-function

steps.name: Add match state, PlayMatch, Back, matchFor and minimal shell case
criteria: PlayMatch shows the match screen and changes nothing else; Back keeps formation and picks; an unknown club or other screens return the same state
matchFor returns the matchday-1 fixture played with the managed side's current eleven against the other side's automatic 4-4-2, and stores nothing; focus goes to the heading
Minimal match case in src/main.ts maps matchFor to a view and throws on an unknown club, keeping the never guard, so ci:typecheck stays green
Same commit git mv-s match-navigation.test.ts.pending into tests/acceptance/S-006/match-navigation.test.ts; S-001..S-005 tests and existing-navigation-unchanged stay unedited and green
ci:lint, ci:typecheck, ci:test and ci:e2e stay green, including names-avoid-match-words
